title: Antenna Tilt Optimization with QAOA on Real Cell-Tower Data
subtitle: Antenna Tilt Optimization
description: This notebook optimizes the electrical tilt of six real cell-tower antennas (OpenCelliD, Tel Aviv) with QAOA. Each antenna gets a 2-qubit tilt register, the interference-minus-coverage cost is encoded directly as a phase Hamiltonian with Qmod's phase() statement, and the circuit is started from angles that were pre-optimized with an exact statevector simulation in Wolfram Mathematica and checked against theorems proved in Lean 4 (the MantiQ Factor workflow). The Classiq run reproduces the predicted expectation value and samples the optimum 27 times more often than uniform.
